parts.zh: M: 早上好，这里是 Safe House Insurance
W: 早上好。从我的处境来看
M: 威尔逊女士，谢谢您再次来电
W: 我是康沃尔郡南海路15号的梅·威尔逊女士
M: 威尔逊女士，根据您账户上的记录
W: 那笔钱已经从我们的账户里扣走了
M: 合同确实规定，一年中任何一次漏缴都会影响保险合同的条款和条件
W: 我已经和他谈过了
W: 那不可能。人类甚至连一只蚊子都造不出来
M: 一旦人工智能得到充分发展
W: 我不太确定。计算机就是计算机

items.stem: What is the woman complaining about?

choices.text: Her house has not been repaired in time.
choices.zh: 她的房子没有被及时修理。

choices.text: She has failed to reach the manager again.
choices.zh: 她再次未能联系到经理。

choices.text: Her claim has been completely disregarded.
choices.zh: 她的索赔完全被忽视了。

choices.text: She has not received any letter from the man.
choices.zh: 她没有收到这位男士的任何信件。

items.stem: What is the problem the woman's family encountered?

choices.text: The ground floor of their cottage was flooded.
choices.zh: 他们小屋的一层被水淹了。

choices.text: Their caravan was washed away by the flood.
choices.zh: 他们的旅行拖车被洪水冲走了。

choices.text: Their entire house was destroyed by the flood.
choices.zh: 他们的整座房子被洪水摧毁了。

choices.text: The roof of their cottage collapsed in the flood.
choices.zh: 他们小屋的屋顶在洪水中坍塌了。

items.stem: What has caused the so-called "bizarre technical detail" according to the man?

choices.text: The woman's misreading of the insurance company's letter.
choices.zh: 这位女士对保险公司信件的误读。

choices.text: The woman's ignorance of the insurance company's policy.
choices.zh: 这位女士对保险公司政策的不了解。

choices.text: The woman's inaccurate description of the whole incident.
choices.zh: 这位女士对整个事件的不准确描述。

choices.text: The woman's failure to pay her house insurance in time.
choices.zh: 这位女士未能及时支付房屋保险费。

items.stem: What does the woman say she would do at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: File a lawsuit against the insurance company.
choices.zh: 对保险公司提起诉讼。

choices.text: Talk to the manager of Safe House Insurance.
choices.zh: 与Safe House Insurance的经理交谈。

choices.text: Consult her lawyer about the insurance policy.
choices.zh: 就保险政策咨询她的律师。

choices.text: Revise the terms and conditions of the contract.
choices.zh: 修改合同的条款和条件。

items.stem: What do we learn about the speakers from the conversation?

choices.text: They work in different fields of AI technology.
choices.zh: 他们在人工智能技术的不同领域工作。

choices.text: They disagree about the future of AI technology.
choices.zh: 他们对人工智能技术的未来持不同看法。

choices.text: They differ greatly in their knowledge of modern technology.
choices.zh: 他们在现代技术知识方面差异很大。

choices.text: They are both worried about the negative impact of technology.
choices.zh: 他们都担心技术的负面影响。

items.stem: What will new kinds of jobs be like, according to the woman?

choices.text: Simply writing AI software.
choices.zh: 仅仅是编写人工智能软件。

choices.text: Stimulating and motivating.
choices.zh: 令人兴奋且有激励性的。

choices.text: Less time-consuming and focusing on creation.
choices.zh: 更省时且专注于创造。

choices.text: More demanding and requiring special training.
choices.zh: 要求更高且需要特殊培训。

items.stem: What is the risk the man anticipates?

choices.text: There could be jobs nobody wants to do.
choices.zh: 可能会有没人愿意做的工作。

choices.text: Digital life could replace human civilization.
choices.zh: 数字生活可能取代人类文明。

choices.text: Humans would be tired of communicating with one another.
choices.zh: 人类会厌倦彼此交流。

choices.text: Old people would be taken care of solely by unfeeling robots.
choices.zh: 老年人将仅由没有感情的机器人照料。

items.stem: What is the man's concern about AI technology?

choices.text: Life will become like a science fiction film.
choices.zh: 生活将变得像科幻电影一样。

choices.text: It will take away humans' jobs altogether.
choices.zh: 它将完全取代人类的工作。

choices.text: Chips will be inserted in human brains.
choices.zh: 芯片将被植入人类大脑。

choices.text: It will be smarter than human beings.
choices.zh: 它将比人类更聪明。

items.stem: What are people under 30 advised to do to achieve financial security?

choices.text: Restrain themselves from high-risk investments.
choices.zh: 克制自己不进行高风险投资。

choices.text: Save one-fifth of their net monthly income.
choices.zh: 储蓄月净收入的五分之一。

choices.text: Invest shrewdly in lucrative businesses.
choices.zh: 精明地投资盈利性业务。

choices.text: Try to earn as much money as possible.
choices.zh: 尽可能多地赚钱。

items.stem: What should people do if they find it difficult to follow the speaker's advice on their financial plan?

choices.text: Start by doing something small.
choices.zh: 从做一些小事开始。

choices.text: Ask a close friend for advice.
choices.zh: 向亲密朋友寻求建议。

choices.text: Try to stick to their initial plan.
choices.zh: 尽量坚持最初的计划。

choices.text: Cut 20% of their daily spending.
choices.zh: 削减日常开支的20%。

items.stem: What does the speaker think is important for achieving financial security?

choices.text: An optimistic attitude.
choices.zh: 乐观的态度。

choices.text: An ambitious plan.
choices.zh: 雄心勃勃的计划。

choices.text: A proper mindset.
choices.zh: 恰当的心态。

choices.text: A keen interest.
choices.zh: 浓厚的兴趣。

items.stem: What do we learn about the speaker when she first started her job?

choices.text: She was uninterested in advertising.
choices.zh: 她对广告不感兴趣。

choices.text: She found her outfit inappropriate.
choices.zh: 她觉得自己的着装不合适。

choices.text: She was unhappy with fashion trends.
choices.zh: 她对时尚潮流感到不满。

choices.text: She often checked herself in a mirror.
choices.zh: 她经常对着镜子检查自己。

items.stem: Why were uniforms invented according to the speaker?

choices.text: To save the trouble of choosing a unique outfit every day.
choices.zh: 为了省去每天选择独特着装的麻烦。

choices.text: To meet the expectations of fashion-conscious clients.
choices.zh: 为了满足注重时尚的客户的期望。

choices.text: To keep up with the current trends.
choices.zh: 为了跟上当前的潮流。

choices.text: To save the expenses on clothing.
choices.zh: 为了节省服装开支。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about looking smarter?

choices.text: It enhances people's ability to work independently.
choices.zh: 它增强了人们独立工作的能力。

choices.text: It helps people succeed in whatever they are doing.
choices.zh: 它帮助人们在所做的任何事情上取得成功。

choices.text: It matters a lot in jobs involving interaction with others.
choices.zh: 在涉及与他人互动的工作中,它非常重要。

choices.text: It boosts one's confidence when looking for employment.
choices.zh: 它在求职时能提升一个人的自信心。

items.stem: What does the speaker advise people to do in an image-obsessed world?

choices.text: Design their own uniform to appear unique.
choices.zh: 设计自己的制服以显得与众不同。

choices.text: Wear classic pieces to impress their clients.
choices.zh: 穿经典款式以给客户留下深刻印象。

choices.text: Fight the ever-changing trends in fashion.
choices.zh: 对抗不断变化的时尚潮流。

choices.text: Do whatever is possible to look smart.
choices.zh: 尽一切可能让自己看起来精明。

items.stem: What has prevented Americans' happiness levels from increasing?

choices.text: Their obsession with consumption.
choices.zh: 他们对消费的痴迷。

choices.text: Their failure to accumulate wealth.
choices.zh: 他们未能积累财富。

choices.text: The ever-increasing costs of housing.
choices.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本。

choices.text: The deterioration of the environment.
choices.zh: 环境的恶化。

items.stem: What things should we possess according to the speaker?

choices.text: Things that are rare to find.
choices.zh: 难以找到的东西。

choices.text: Things that cost less money.
choices.zh: 花费更少钱的东西。

choices.text: Things that boost efficiency.
choices.zh: 提高效率的东西。

choices.text: Things that we cherish most.
choices.zh: 我们最珍视的东西。

items.stem: What do we learn about the items in the speaker's home?

choices.text: They serve multiple purposes.
choices.zh: 它们有多种用途。

choices.text: They benefit the environment.
choices.zh: 它们有益于环境。

choices.text: They are mostly durable.
choices.zh: 它们大多经久耐用。

choices.text: They are easily disposable.
choices.zh: 它们容易丢弃。

items.stem: What did a team of scientists find in their study?

choices.text: All respondents were afraid of making a high expense claim.
choices.zh: 所有受访者都害怕提出高额费用报销。

choices.text: A number of respondents gave an average answer of 400 miles.
choices.zh: 一些受访者给出的平均答案是400英里。

choices.text: Over 10% of the respondents lied about the distance they drove.
choices.zh: 超过10%的受访者谎报了他们驾驶的距离。

choices.text: Most of the respondents got compensated for driving 384 miles.
choices.zh: 大多数受访者因驾驶384英里而获得了补偿。

items.stem: Why would people fabricate numbers to their own detriment according to the researchers?

choices.text: They responded to colleagues' suspicion.
choices.zh: 他们回应了同事的怀疑。

choices.text: They cared about other people's claims.
choices.zh: 他们在意其他人的报销申请。

choices.text: They wanted to protect their reputation.
choices.zh: 他们想要保护自己的声誉。

choices.text: They endeavored to actually be honest.
choices.zh: 他们努力做到真正诚实。

items.stem: What does the speaker think of the researchers' findings?

choices.text: They seem positive.
choices.zh: 它们似乎是积极的。

choices.text: They seem intuitive.
choices.zh: 它们似乎是直观的。

choices.text: They are illustrative.
choices.zh: 它们具有说明性。

choices.text: They are conclusive.
choices.zh: 它们是结论性的。

items.stem: What does the speaker mainly discuss in this talk?

choices.text: Deterioration in the quality of new music.
choices.zh: 新音乐质量的下降。

choices.text: Insights into the features of good music.
choices.zh: 对好音乐特征的见解。

choices.text: Older people's changing musical tastes.
choices.zh: 老年人不断变化的音乐品味。

choices.text: Older people's aversion to new music.
choices.zh: 老年人对新音乐的厌恶。

items.stem: What have studies found about most people by the time they turn 33?

choices.text: They no longer listen to new music.
choices.zh: 他们不再听新音乐。

choices.text: They find all music sounds the same.
choices.zh: 他们觉得所有音乐听起来都一样。

choices.text: They can make subtle distinctions about music.
choices.zh: 他们能够对音乐做出细微的区分。

choices.text: They seldom listen to songs released in their teens.
choices.zh: 他们很少听青少年时期发行的歌曲。

items.stem: What do we learn from one of the most researched laws of social psychology?

choices.text: The more you are exposed to something, the more familiar it'll be to you.
choices.zh: 你接触某事物越多,它对你就越熟悉。

choices.text: The more you are exposed to something, the deeper you'll understand it.
choices.zh: 你接触某事物越多,你对它的理解就越深。

choices.text: The more you experience something, the longer you'll remember it.
choices.zh: 你体验某事物越多,你记住它的时间就越长。

choices.text: The more you experience something, the better you'll appreciate it.
choices.zh: 你体验某事物越多,你就越会欣赏它。

items.stem: What might explain the fact that songs people listen to in their teen years are memorable and beloved?

choices.text: Teenagers' memories are more lasting.
choices.zh: 青少年的记忆更持久。

choices.text: Teenagers' emotions are more intense.
choices.zh: 青少年的情感更强烈。

choices.text: Teenagers are much more sensitive.
choices.zh: 青少年要敏感得多。

choices.text: Teenagers are much more sentimental.
choices.zh: 青少年要多愁善感得多。
